decision: Retain the DOS 6.0-identical INT 2Ah critical-section definitions.
evidence: The source matches DOS 6.0 and astro byte for byte.
DOS CRIT and SEGCHECK include int2a.inc; CRIT uses critDisk and critDevice in generated instructions.
All 128 linked bytes of the previously compared CRIT module match target MSDOS.SYS (review 049).
The selected SEGCHECK build has DEBUG=0 and emits no code (review 105).
limitations: The target comparison supports constants exercised by CRIT, not all documented network functions or debug configurations. Full kernel linking and equality remain unverified.
